issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 15,689.94 (Special Revenue Fund column)
issues.issue: The Special Revenue Fund's investments are 195,590.05 at the start of the year and 203,804.19 at the end. The end figure equals 'STFIIT #2-Keno' on the p3 Schedule of Investments, so this fund appears to be the keno fund and its 'Other' receipts are probably keno/lottery proceeds. The printed label says Other and the user's category decision applies, so this is left as a judgment call.

Receipts of the utility (water/wastewater) Enterprise Fund. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, utility fund sales/charges go in the receipt category 'Utility Charges', not the general charges for services category. The amount and the split by fund column are correct.

This is a capital outlay line. The user's labelling rule calls for 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways' with the printed text kept in printed_label. The category and amount are correct; user_rules.py should apply the label.
